主要内容: The document titled 'Form 6-K' is a regulatory filing by the Royal Bank of Canada, published on February 28, 2013. It includes the First Quarter 2013 Earnings Release, a Report to Shareholders, and other financial disclosures. The filing is part of the Royal Bank of Canada's compliance with U.S. securities regulations, specifically under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The report incorporates management's discussion and analysis and unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements. The filing is referenced in several Registration Statements on Form F-3 and S-8. The document is signed by Janice R. Fukakusa, who holds the title of Chief Administrative Officer and Chief Financial Officer.
